1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
4	#
5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
23	#
24	# Usage:
25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
29	#
30	# Options:
31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
34	#                       alias --workspace
35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
36	#   --trial N           trial number
37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
47	#
48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
58	#
59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
88	#
89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
95	#
96	# Exit codes:
97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
107	#
108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
111	#
112	# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
113	# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
114	#
115	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
116	# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
117	# =============================================================================
118	set -euo pipefail
119	export LC_ALL=C
120	shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal
121	
122	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
123	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
124	PROMPTS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts"
125	# No .claude/ code is sourced (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary": the
126	# harness is the trusted copy and runs against a PR's .claude/).
127	
128	TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE=""
129	MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
130	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
131	PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS:-}" PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="" DRY_RUN=false
132	SPRINT="sprint-1"
133	TOOLS_DEFAULT="Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"
134	
135	die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
136	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
137	  case "$1" in
138	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
139	    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
140	    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
141	    --run-id)         RUN_ID="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
142	    --trial)          TRIAL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
143	    --source-tree)    SOURCE_TREE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
144	    --suite-file)     SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
145	    --max-run-usd)    MAX_RUN_USD="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
146	    --executor)       EXECUTOR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
147	    --image)          IMAGE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
148	    --claude-bin)     CLAUDE_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
149	    --docker-bin)     DOCKER_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
150	    --phase-models)   PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
151	    --phase-timeouts) PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
152	    --dry-run)        DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
153	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,105p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
154	    *) die_usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
155	  esac
156	done
157	
158	for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
159	  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"
160	done
161	[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
162	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
163	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die_usage "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
164	[[ -d "$SOURCE_TREE" ]] || die_usage "source tree not found: $SOURCE_TREE"
165	[[ "$TRIAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die_usage "--trial must be an integer"
166	case "$EXECUTOR" in container|host) ;; *) die_usage "--executor must be container or host" ;; esac
167	for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
168	[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
169	[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
170	[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
171	[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'
172	
173	TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
174	TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
175	SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
176	SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"
177	
178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
179	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"
180	
181	if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
182	  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
183	  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
184	  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
185	fi
186	[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
187	CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"
188	
189	TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
190	TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
191	[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
192	case "$TASK_TYPE" in
193	  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
194	  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
195	  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
196	esac
197	
198	# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
199	ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
200	ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
201	REFUSAL=""
202	if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
203	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
204	elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
205	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
206	elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
207	       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
208	       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
209	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
210	fi
211	[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
212	SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
213	
214	# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
215	plan_phases() {
216	  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
217	    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
218	    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
219	    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
220	    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
221	    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
222	          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
223	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
224	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
225	        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
226	    | .out'
227	}
228	
229	phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
230	  case "$1" in
231	    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
232	    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
233	  esac
234	}
235	builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
236	builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
237	builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }
238	
239	phase_model() {
240	  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
241	    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
242	}
243	phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
244	               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
245	  local n="$1" key="$2" v
246	  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
247	  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
248	  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
249	    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
250	  fi
251	  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
252	    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
253	  fi
254	  printf '%s' "$v"
255	}
256	phase_timeout_s() {
257	  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
258	  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
259	}
260	TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
261	EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
262	case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac
263	
264	if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
265	  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
266	  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
267	  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
268	  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
269	  i=0
270	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
271	    i=$((i + 1))
272	    sess=new
273	    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
274	    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
275	    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
276	      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
277	      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
278	  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
279	  exit 0
280	fi
281	
282	# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
283	if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
284	  die_usage "run dir exists and is not empty: $RUN_DIR"
285	fi
286	mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
287	RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
288	WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"
289	mkdir -p "$WS" "$META" "$SNAPS" "$TRANS" "$EVALD"
290	printf '%s\n' "$ARM" > "$META/arm"
291	PHASES_FILE="$META/phases.jsonl"; : > "$PHASES_FILE"
292	export ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$META/arm-evidence.txt"; : > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
293	MOUNT_LOG="$META/mount.log"; : > "$MOUNT_LOG"
294	
295	STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
296	STATUS="running" CAP_PHASE="" CAP_TURN="null" REASON="" FINAL_WRITTEN=0
297	INTERRUPTED=0 CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
298	SPENT_MICRO=0 IMAGE_DIGEST="" FINGERPRINT="" SNAPSHOTS_JSON='{}' TOGGLES="$SUITE_TOGGLES"
299	SOURCE_COMMIT="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
300	SUITE_VERSION="$(jq -c --argjson t "$TASK_JSON" '$t.suite_version // .suite_version // .version // null' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
#
# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
#
# Usage:
#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
#
# Options:
#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
#                       alias --workspace
#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
#   --trial N           trial number
#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
#
# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
#
# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
#
# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
#
# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
PROMPTS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts"
# No .claude/ code is sourced (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary": the
# harness is the trusted copy and runs against a PR's .claude/).

TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE=""
MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS:-}" PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="" DRY_RUN=false
SPRINT="sprint-1"
TOOLS_DEFAULT="Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"

die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id)         RUN_ID="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial)          TRIAL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --source-tree)    SOURCE_TREE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --suite-file)     SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --max-run-usd)    MAX_RUN_USD="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --executor)       EXECUTOR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --image)          IMAGE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --claude-bin)     CLAUDE_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --docker-bin)     DOCKER_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --phase-models)   PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --phase-timeouts) PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --dry-run)        DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,105p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) die_usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
  esac
done

for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"
done
[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die_usage "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
[[ -d "$SOURCE_TREE" ]] || die_usage "source tree not found: $SOURCE_TREE"
[[ "$TRIAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die_usage "--trial must be an integer"
case "$EXECUTOR" in container|host) ;; *) die_usage "--executor must be container or host" ;; esac
for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"

TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
fi
[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

phase_model() {
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  exit 0
fi

# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then

fi
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"

export ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$META/arm-evidence.txt"; : > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
MOUNT_LOG="$META/mount.log"; : > "$MOUNT_LOG"

now_ms() {  # epoch milliseconds; whole seconds × 1000 where date has no %N (BSD date)

remove_tree() {  # remove_tree <dir> — permission-tolerant delete (credential copies)

evidence_json() {
  jq -Rn '[inputs | select(test("^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+=")) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$")]
          | reduce .[] as $e ({}; .[$e.k] = $e.v)' < "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"

write_pipeline() {  # write_pipeline — (re)write meta/pipeline.json from the current state
  local phases ev finished
  phases="$(jq -sc '.' "$PHASES_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  ev="$(evidence_json 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')"
  finished=null

  jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" --arg arm "$ARM" --arg task_id "$TASK_ID" --arg task_type "$TASK_TYPE" \
    --argjson trial "$TRIAL" --arg source_commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" --argjson suite_version "$SUITE_VERSION" \
    --argjson phases "$phases" --arg status "$STATUS" --arg cap_phase "$CAP_PHASE" --argjson cap_turn "$CAP_TURN" \
    --arg reason "$REASON" --argjson arm_evidence "$ev" --argjson toggles "$TOGGLES" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" \
    --arg image_digest "$IMAGE_DIGEST" --arg fingerprint "$FINGERPRINT" --arg tools "$TOOLS" \
    --argjson snapshots "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --argjson spent "$SPENT_MICRO" --arg cap "$MAX_RUN_USD" --arg effort "$EFFORT_FLAG" '
    {schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, arm: $arm, task_id: $task_id, task_type: $task_type, trial: $trial,
     source_commit: $source_commit, suite_version: $suite_version, status: $status,
     cap_phase: (if $cap_phase == "" then null else $cap_phase end), cap_turn: $cap_turn,
     reason: (if $reason == "" then null else $reason end),
     max_run_usd: ($cap | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent / 1000000),
     arm_toggles: $toggles, effort_flag: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end), arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
     executor_mode: $executor, image_digest: (if $image_digest == "" then null else $image_digest end),
     fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end), sandbox_fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end),
     tools: $tools, snapshots: $snapshots, phases: $phases, started: $started, finished: $finished}' \

finish() {  # finish <status> <exit> [reason]
  STATUS="$1"; [[ -n "${3:-}" ]] && REASON="$3"
  write_pipeline

578	price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
579	  local m="$1" hit alias j
580	  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
581	  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
582	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
583	    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
584	  else
585	    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
586	    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
587	          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
588	    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
589	  fi
590	  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
591	              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
592	                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
593	                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
594	              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
595	  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
596	  printf '%s' "$j"
597	}
598	# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
599	price_events() {
600	  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
601	    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
602	                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
603	    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
604	                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
605	      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
606	       .n += 1
607	       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
608	       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
609	       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
610	    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
611	    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
612	         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
613	    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
614	}

619	
620	# ENV_SHIM <keys-csv> <cmd…>: close every descriptor above 2 (DEC-0412), keep exactly the
621	# named environment variables, exec <cmd>. Used on the host (host mode, and around the
622	# docker client) and inside the container. No eval (eval.yml trust boundary), and secret
623	# values never appear in any argv: they travel in the environment only.
624	ENV_SHIM='import os, sys
625	keys = [k for k in sys.argv[1].split(",") if k]
626	env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in keys if k in os.environ}
627	os.closerange(3, 65536)
628	os.execvpe(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:], env)'
629	# pass-through keys, taken from the driver's environment when set; SECRET_KEYS are never
630	# written to an argv or a capture (recorded as <set>)
631	PASS_KEYS="AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL"
632	SECRET_KEYS=" AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK "

636	  local -a cargv envkv full

639	  tsec="$(phase_timeout_s "$name")"
640	  prompt_file="$META/prompt-$label.md"
641	  events="$TRANS/events-$label.jsonl"; errf="$TRANS/stderr-$label.log"
642	  argv_file="$META/phase-$label.argv.json"
643	  build_prompt "$name" "$prompt_file"
644	  local why; why="$(leak_scan "$prompt_file")" || infra "phase prompt $label leaks $why"
645	
646	  local resume=""

648	    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) resume="$IMPL_SESSION" ;; esac
649	  fi

651	  cargv=("$cbin" -p "$(cat "$prompt_file")" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model "$model"
652	         --permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project
653	         --tools "$TOOLS" --max-turns "$turns")
654	  [[ -n "$EFFORT_FLAG" ]] && cargv+=(--effort "$EFFORT_FLAG")

price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
  local m="$1" hit alias j
  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  else
    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
  fi
  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
  printf '%s' "$j"
}
# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
price_events() {
  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
       .n += 1
       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
}

# --- phase execution ----------------------------------------------------------------
IMPL_SESSION="" LAST_VERDICT="none" CUR_LABEL=""
in_container_path() { local p="$1"; printf '%s' "/workspace${p#"$WS"}"; }

# ENV_SHIM <keys-csv> <cmd…>: close every descriptor above 2 (DEC-0412), keep exactly the
# named environment variables, exec <cmd>. Used on the host (host mode, and around the
# docker client) and inside the container. No eval (eval.yml trust boundary), and secret
# values never appear in any argv: they travel in the environment only.
ENV_SHIM='import os, sys
keys = [k for k in sys.argv[1].split(",") if k]
env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in keys if k in os.environ}
os.closerange(3, 65536)
os.execvpe(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:], env)'
# pass-through keys, taken from the driver's environment when set; SECRET_KEYS are never
# written to an argv or a capture (recorded as <set>)
PASS_KEYS="AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL"
SECRET_KEYS=" AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK "

run_phase() {  # run_phase <name> <label>
  local name="$1" label="$2" model turns tsec prompt_file events errf argv_file
  local -a cargv envkv full
  model="$(phase_model "$name")"
  turns="$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)"
  tsec="$(phase_timeout_s "$name")"
  prompt_file="$META/prompt-$label.md"
  events="$TRANS/events-$label.jsonl"; errf="$TRANS/stderr-$label.log"
  argv_file="$META/phase-$label.argv.json"
  build_prompt "$name" "$prompt_file"
  local why; why="$(leak_scan "$prompt_file")" || infra "phase prompt $label leaks $why"

  local resume=""
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -n "$IMPL_SESSION" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) resume="$IMPL_SESSION" ;; esac
  fi
  local cbin="$CLAUDE_BIN"; [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && cbin="${LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
  cargv=("$cbin" -p "$(cat "$prompt_file")" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model "$model"
         --permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project
         --tools "$TOOLS" --max-turns "$turns")
  [[ -n "$EFFORT_FLAG" ]] && cargv+=(--effort "$EFFORT_FLAG")
  [[ -n "$resume" ]] && cargv+=(--resume "$resume")

  local ev_ws="$WS" home_v="$HOME" path_v="$PATH"
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    ev_ws="/workspace"; home_v="/home/evaluser"; path_v="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
  fi
  envkv=("PATH=$path_v" "HOME=$home_v" "LANG=${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" "LC_ALL=$LC_ALL" "TERM=${TERM:-dumb}"
         "TMPDIR=$ev_ws/.eval/tmp" "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=${CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK:-1}")
  local pk
  for pk in $PASS_KEYS; do
    if [[ -n "${!pk:-}" ]]; then envkv+=("$pk=${!pk}"); fi
  done
  envkv+=("CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$model"
          "LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl"
          "LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl"
          "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null" "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1" "GH_CONFIG_DIR=$ev_ws/.eval/gh-empty")
  local kv_arm have_enforce=false
  while IFS= read -r kv_arm; do
    [[ "$kv_arm" =~ ^LOA_[A-Z0-9_]+= ]] || continue    # the arm's own variables only (never PATH, HOME, keys)
    envkv+=("$kv_arm"); [[ "$kv_arm" == LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=* ]] && have_enforce=true
  done < <(LC_ALL=C sort -u "$ARM_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ "$GATES_OFF" == true && "$have_enforce" == false ]] && envkv+=("LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false")

  local cname="" keys="" kv k
  for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do keys="$keys${keys:+,}${kv%%=*}"; done
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    cname="loa-abl-$(printf '%s-%s' "$RUN_ID" "$label" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '-' | cut -c1-100)"
    # the docker client keeps only what it needs plus the secrets it forwards by name
    local hostkeys="PATH,HOME,DOCKER_HOST,DOCKER_CONFIG,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
    for k in $SECRET_KEYS; do if [[ -n "${!k:-}" ]]; then hostkeys="$hostkeys,$k"; fi; done
    full=(python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$hostkeys"
          "$DOCKER_BIN" run --rm --name "$cname" --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)"
          --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g
          --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
          -v "$WS:/workspace:rw"
          -v "$HOME_DIR:/home/evaluser:rw"

      launcher_argv: $launcher, container: ($executor == "container")}' > "$argv_file"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under

   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
   153	  exit 0
   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
   158	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
   159	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   160	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
   161	[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
   162	jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
   163	[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
   164	if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
   165	  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
   166	fi
   167	[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
   168	GRADE_JSON=null
   169	if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
   170	  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
   171	  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
   172	fi
   173	MAN_JSON='{}'
   174	if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
   175	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
   176	  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
   177	fi
   178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
   179	PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
   180	RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
   181	
   182	# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
   183	META_ARM=""
   184	[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   185	MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
   186	if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
   187	  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
   188	fi
   189	ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
   190	[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
   191	
   192	# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
   193	MINV='[]'
   194	if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   195	  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
   196	          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
   197	                         | select(.row != null)]')"
   198	fi
   199	
   200	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
   201	  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
   202	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
   203	  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
   204	}
   205	ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
   206	ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
   207	
   208	# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
   209	DOT_WRITES='[]'
   210	shopt -s nullglob
   211	ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
   212	shopt -u nullglob
   213	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   214	  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
   215	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
   216	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
   217	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
   218	                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
   219	        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
   220	        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
   221	    done | jq -s -c '.')"
   222	fi
   223	
   224	ROW="$(jq -n -c \
   225	  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
   226	  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
   227	  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
   228	  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
   229	  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
   230	  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
   231	  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
   232	      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
   233	       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
   234	       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
   235	       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
   236	  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
   237	  | [ $ran[] as $ph
   238	      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
   239	      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
   240	      | $ph + {
   241	          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
   242	          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
   243	          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
   244	                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
   245	                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
   246	                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
   247	          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
   248	        } ] as $phases
   249	  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
   250	        | .model_requested as $req
   251	        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
   252	          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
   253	          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
   254	      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
   255	          | voices($e) as $v
   256	          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
   257	            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
   258	                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
   259	    ) as $why
   260	  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
   261	  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
   262	     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
   263	     else $pst end) as $status
   264	  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
   265	  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
   266	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
   267	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
   268	  | {
   269	      schema_version: 1,
   270	      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
   271	      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
   272	      arm: $arm,
   273	      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
   274	      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
   275	      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
   276	      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
   277	      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
   278	      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
   279	      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
   280	      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
   281	      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
   282	      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
   283	      started: ($p.started // ""),
   284	      finished: ($p.finished // null),
   285	      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
   286	                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
   287	                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
   288	                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
   289	                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
   290	                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
   291	                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
   292	      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
   293	      hidden_tests: $ht,
   294	      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
   295	      defects_seeded: $seeded,
   296	      defects_caught: $caught,
   297	      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
   298	                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
   299	                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
   300	      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
   301	      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
   302	      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
   303	      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end),
   304	      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
   305	                                else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review end),
   306	      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
   307	                               else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.audit end),
   308	      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
   309	                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
   310	      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
   311	      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
   312	      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
   313	      wall_clock_ms: (if $p.started != null and $p.finished != null then (ms($p.finished) - ms($p.started))
   314	                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
   315	      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
   316	      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
   317	      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
   318	      attempts: $attempts,
   319	      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
   320	      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
   321	      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
   322	      status: $status,
   323	      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
   324	      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
   325	      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
   326	      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot}
   327	    }')"
   328	
   329	if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
   330	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   331	  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   332	    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
   333	  else
   334	    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
   335	  fi
   336	else
   337	  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
   338	fi
