1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"

   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1

   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"

   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"

   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"

   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"

   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))

   166	  done < <(argv_files)

   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"

   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }

   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"

   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"

   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"

   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))

   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"

   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   142	}
   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   155	}
   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   160	}
   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   166	  done < <(argv_files)
   167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   170	}
   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   177	  fi
   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   181	}
   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines

  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
  done
  return 0
}

     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/

    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)

    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#

    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.

    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?

    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0
   125	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   126	# =============================================================================
   127	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
   128	#
   129	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
   130	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
   131	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
   132	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
   133	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
   134	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
   135	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
   136	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
   137	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
   138	#
   139	# Usage:
   140	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
   141	#
   142	# Options:
   143	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
   144	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
   145	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
   146	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
   147	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
   148	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
   149	#
   150	# Exit codes:
   151	#   0  printed
   152	#   2  usage error
   153	#
   154	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
   155	# =============================================================================
   156	set -euo pipefail
   157	export LC_ALL=C
   158	
   159	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
   160	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
   161	
   162	SOURCE_TREE=""
   163	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   164	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
   165	JSON=false
   166	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   167	  case "$1" in
   168	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   169	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   170	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   171	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
   172	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
   173	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
   174	  esac
   175	done
   176	if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
   177	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
   178	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
   179	fi
   180	
   181	# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
   182	tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
   183	  local bin="$1"; shift
   184	  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
   185	  local out
   186	  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
   187	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
   188	  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
   189	  printf '%s' "$out"
   190	}
   191	
   192	lines="$(
   193	  {
   194	    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
   195	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
   196	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
   197	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
   198	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
   199	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
   200	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
   201	    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
   202	    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
   203	  } | LC_ALL=C sort
   204	)"
   205	src="none"
   206	if [[ -n "$SOURCE_TREE" ]]; then
   207	  src="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
   208	fi
   209	lines="$lines"$'\n'"source_tree=$src"
   210	digest="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')"
   211	fp="fp:$digest"
   212	
   213	if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   214	  printf '%s\n' "$lines" | jq -Rn --arg fp "$fp" --arg src "$src" '
   215	    [inputs | select(length > 0)] as $l
   216	    | {fingerprint: $fp, source_tree: $src, lines: $l,
   217	       tools: ($l | map(select(startswith("source_tree=") | not) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}) | add)}'
   218	else
   219	  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
   220	fi

   344	    task_md = read(os.path.join(tdir, "TASK.md"))
   345	    if task_md is None:
   346	        bad(tid, "schema: TASK.md is missing")
   347	        task_md = ""
   348	    leak_scan(tid, "TASK.md", task_md, stems, defect_ids)
   349	    leak_scan(tid, "criterion", crit, stems, defect_ids)
   350	    for label, text in prompt_texts:
   351	        leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids)
   352	
   353	if not allow_partial:
   354	    for ty in TYPES:
   355	        if counts[ty] != 4:
   356	            bad("suite", f"counts: {counts[ty]} {ty} task(s) under tasks/, want 4 (pass --allow-partial before the freeze)")
   357	
   358	for o in out:
   359	    print(o)
   360	PY
   361	
   362	violations=0
   363	: > "$WORK/report.txt"
   364	while IFS= read -r line; do
   365	  if [[ "$line" == FIXTURE$'\t'* ]]; then
   366	    IFS=$'\t' read -r _ tid fdir <<<"$line"
   367	    if ! check_fixture_path_rule "$fdir" 2>"$WORK/rule.err"; then
   368	      printf '%s: fixture path rule: %s\n' "$tid" "$(tr '\n' ' ' < "$WORK/rule.err" | sed 's/ *$//')" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
   369	    fi
   370	  else
   371	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
   372	  fi
   373	done < "$WORK/out.txt"
   374	violations="$(grep -c . "$WORK/report.txt" || true)"
   375	ntasks="$(grep -c . "$WORK/tasks.tsv" || true)"
   376	if [[ "$violations" -gt 0 ]]; then
   377	  cat "$WORK/report.txt"
   378	  echo "validate-suite: $violations violation(s) over $ntasks task(s) in $ROOT" >&2
   379	  exit 1
   380	fi
   381	echo "validate-suite: OK — $ntasks task(s) valid in $ROOT$([[ "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" == "true" ]] && echo " (partial: type counts not enforced)")"
   382	exit 0

1	# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
     2	# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
     3	# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
     4	# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
     5	# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
     6	# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
     7	# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
     8	# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
     9	#
    10	# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
    11	#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
    12	# Run:
    13	#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
    14	#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
    15	#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
    16	#
    17	# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
    18	#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
    19	FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
    20	RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
    21	
    22	FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base
    23	
    24	ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
    25	ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
    26	ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
    27	ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0
    28	
    29	RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    30	    bash \
    31	    git \
    32	    jq \
    33	    python3 \
    34	    python3-pip \
    35	    python3-venv \
    36	    grep \
    37	    diffutils \
    38	    coreutils \
    39	    procps \
    40	    ca-certificates \
    41	    curl \
    42	    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    43	
    44	# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
    45	ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
    46	ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
    47	ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
    48	RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    49	    case "$arch" in \
    50	      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
    51	      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
    52	      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    53	    esac && \
    54	    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
    55	      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    56	    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    57	    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
    58	
    59	# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
    60	RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
    61	      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
    62	      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    63	    && npm cache clean --force
    64	
    65	# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)

    67	# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
    68	# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
    69	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"
    70	
    71	# bats-core at the pinned tag
    72	RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    73	    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    74	    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
    75	
    76	# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
    77	RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
    78	
    79	# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
    80	# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
    81	RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
    82	# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
    83	# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
    84	# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
    85	RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    86	    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
    87	
    88	ENV TZ=UTC
    89	ENV LC_ALL=C
    90	ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
    91	ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
    92	ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
    93	
    94	USER evaluser
    95	WORKDIR /workspace
    96	
    97	# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
    98	RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    99	    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
   100	    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
   101	    echo "All tools verified"
   102	
   103	ENTRYPOINT []
   104	CMD ["/bin/bash"]
   105	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   106	# =============================================================================
   107	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
   108	#
   109	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
   110	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
   111	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
   112	#
   113	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
   114	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
   115	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
   116	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
   117	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
   118	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
   119	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
   120	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
   121	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
   122	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
   123	#                    submodule from there; no network).
   124	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
   125	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
   126	#      is printed, then a summary line
   127	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
   128	#
   129	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
   130	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
   131	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
   132	#
   133	# Usage:
   134	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
   135	#
   136	# Options:
   137	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
   138	#                repository the script lives in)
   139	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
   140	#                (use before the change is committed)
   141	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
   142	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
   143	#                /tmp)
   144	#   -h, --help   this text
   145	#
   146	# Exit codes:
   147	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
   148	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
   149	#   2    usage error
   150	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
   151	#        the failing step's output is printed
   152	# =============================================================================
   153	set -euo pipefail
   154	export LC_ALL=C
   155	
   156	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
   157	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   158	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
   159	
   160	REF=""
   161	KEEP=0
   162	WORKTREE=0
   163	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
   164	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   165	  case "$1" in
   166	    --ref)
   167	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
   168	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   169	    --tmp)
   170	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
   171	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   172	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
   173	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
   174	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
   175	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
   176	  esac
   177	done
   178	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
   179	
   180	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
   181	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
   182	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
   183	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
   184	
   185	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
   186	cleanup() {
   187	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
   188	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
   189	  else
   190	    rm -rf "$WORK"
   191	  fi
   192	}
   193	trap cleanup EXIT
   194	
   195	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
   196	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
   197	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
   198	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
   199	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
   200	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
   201	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
   202	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
   203	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   204	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   205	
   206	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   207	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   208	  local desc="$1"; shift
   209	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   210	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   211	    die3 "$desc"
   212	  fi
   213	}
   214	
   215	suffix=""
   216	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   217	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   218	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   219	
   220	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   221	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   222	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   223	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   224	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   225	
   226	overlay() {
   227	  local p
   228	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   229	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   230	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   231	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   232	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   233	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   234	    else
   235	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   236	    fi
   237	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   238	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   239	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   240	}
   241	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   242	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   243	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   244	
   245	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   246	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   247	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   248	init_downstream() {
   249	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   250	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   251	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   252	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   253	}
   254	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   255	
   256	do_mount() {
   257	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   258	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   259	}
   260	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   261	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   262	
   263	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   264	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   265	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   266	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   267	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   268	else
   269	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   270	fi
   271	
   272	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   273	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"

   105	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   106	# =============================================================================
   107	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
   108	#
   109	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
   110	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
   111	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
   112	#
   113	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
   114	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
   115	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
   116	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
   117	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
   118	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
   119	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
   120	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
   121	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
   122	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
   123	#                    submodule from there; no network).
   124	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
   125	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
   126	#      is printed, then a summary line
   127	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
   128	#
   129	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
   130	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
   131	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
   132	#
   133	# Usage:
   134	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
   135	#
   136	# Options:
   137	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
   138	#                repository the script lives in)
   139	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
   140	#                (use before the change is committed)
   141	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
   142	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
   143	#                /tmp)
   144	#   -h, --help   this text
   145	#
   146	# Exit codes:
   147	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
   148	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
   149	#   2    usage error
   150	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
   151	#        the failing step's output is printed
   152	# =============================================================================
   153	set -euo pipefail
   154	export LC_ALL=C
   155	
   156	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
   157	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   158	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
   159	
   160	REF=""
   161	KEEP=0
   162	WORKTREE=0
   163	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
   164	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   165	  case "$1" in
   166	    --ref)
   167	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
   168	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   169	    --tmp)
   170	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
   171	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   172	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
   173	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
   174	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
   175	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
   176	  esac
   177	done
   178	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
   179	
   180	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
   181	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
   182	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
   183	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
   184	
   185	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
   186	cleanup() {
   187	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
   188	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
   189	  else
   190	    rm -rf "$WORK"
   191	  fi
   192	}
   193	trap cleanup EXIT
   194	
   195	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
   196	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
   197	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
   198	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
   199	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
   200	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
   201	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
   202	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
   203	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   204	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   205	
   206	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   207	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   208	  local desc="$1"; shift
   209	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   210	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   211	    die3 "$desc"
   212	  fi
   213	}
   214	
   215	suffix=""
   216	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"

   218	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   219	
   220	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   221	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   222	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   223	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   224	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   225	
   226	overlay() {
   227	  local p
   228	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   229	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   230	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   231	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   232	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   233	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   234	    else
   235	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   236	    fi
   237	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   238	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   239	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   240	}
   241	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   242	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   243	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   244	
   245	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   246	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   247	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   248	init_downstream() {
   249	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   250	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   251	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   252	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   253	}
   254	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   255	
   256	do_mount() {
   257	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   258	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   259	}
   260	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   261	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   262	
   263	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   264	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   265	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   266	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   267	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   268	else
   269	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   270	fi
   271	
   272	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   273	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   274	rc=0
   275	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   276	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   277	cat "$OUT"
   278	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   279	
   280	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   281	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   282	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   283	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   284	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
